items.title: Investor's Last Exam: Can AI Agents Do Equity Investment Without Seeing the Future?
items.claim: Even leading AI agents cannot convert broad equity-research competence into accurate financial forecasts.

items.title: Decorrelating the Advice Layer: A Calibrated Fragility Metric and Tested Mitigations for Synchronized Liquidation in Agentic Wealth Management
items.claim: Tail liquidation in agentic wealth management rises with synchronized automation not model concentration.

items.title: FilingLoop: Evaluating and Evolving LLM Agents for Corporate Disclosure Review and Revision
items.claim: Cross-case procedural learning raises disclosure review requirement fulfillment without updating model weights.

items.title: EPSBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Earnings Forecasting
items.claim: Most LLM earnings forecast intervals miss actual EPS because forecasts run low.

items.title: TreasuryQA Bench: Can AI Agents Work an Archive of Scanned Financial Records?
items.claim: Even top agents solve under two thirds of scanned archive questions and fail mainly on digit misreads.

items.title: Errors With No Common Sign: Certified Evaluation of Quantum and LLM Components in Financial Pipelines
items.claim: Mechanical classical certification overturned financial quantum ML results in both directions and shows no quantum advantage.
